gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed histologically confirmed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma multiforme (WHO grade IV). Patients with secondary glioblastoma, in particular those who are IDH1 or IDH2 mutant, will not be excluded.

candidate_evidence.quote: Personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine supplied by Geneos Therapeutics (other names: GNOS-PV01, Vaccine): -The neoantigen DNA vaccines are also known as DNA plasmid vector expressing tumor-specific antigens.
As this study aims to assess the immunogenicity of personalized neoantigen DNA vaccine plus plasmid encoded IL-12 as an adjuvant, no prior immunotherapy will be permitted.

candidate_flag.reason: Plasmid-encoded IL-12 (INO-9012) is registered as a Drug; coded as gene-based vaccine adjuvant (excluded type), but if treated as a pharmacological biologic it would be a candidate.

coder_notes: Population is MGMT-unmethylated newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme; IDH-mutant secondary glioblastoma explicitly allowed, hence historical terminology. IDH is mentioned only as not excluded, so not recorded as a biomarker. Radiotherapy is standard of care outside study scope; no temozolomide is mentioned. The CELLECTRA 2000 electroporation device is not listed as an agent. Bevacizumab is permitted for oedema but is not a study intervention, so not listed. The neoantigen requirement appears as an exclusion criterion (no candidate neoantigen identified) and functions as an entry requirement.
